code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda x: sum(r.count(x) for r in grid))
    marks = [(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg and not ((r in (0,h-1)) or (c in (0,w-1)))]
    for r,c,col in marks:
        out[r][c] = 4
        # extend from each marker toward the nearest parallel edge bar
        if any(grid[h-1][cc] != bg for cc in range(c-1,c+2) if 0 <= cc < w):
            for rr in range(r+1,h-1): out[rr][c] = col
        elif any(grid[0][cc] != bg for cc in range(c-1,c+2) if 0 <= cc < w):
            for rr in range(r-1,0,-1): out[rr][c] = col
        elif any(grid[rr][w-1] != bg for rr in range(r-1,r+2) if 0 <= rr < h):
            for cc in range(c+1,w-1): out[r][cc] = col
        elif any(grid[rr][0] != bg for rr in range(r-1,r+2) if 0 <= rr < h):
            for cc in range(c-1,0,-1): out[r][cc] = col
    return out
